components.name: GhostText
components.description: Draws the suffix over an input or textarea, after an invisible copy of the value. It copies the field's box, padding and font so the suffix lands where the next typed letter would, and follows the field's scroll.

props.name: multiline
props.description: Wraps like a textarea instead of running on one line.

props.name: error
props.description: Error to show under the field, e.g. from the server. Marks the field invalid and overrides the built-in checks while set.

props.name: onValidityChange
props.description: Fires when the field's validity changes, whether or not the error is showing yet.

props.name: type
props.description: Defaults to "text". "email", "url" and "number" also get their built-in checks.

props.name: label
props.description: Floating label. Used by the filled and outlined variants.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Shows the error style. Same as passing aria-invalid.

props.name: leading
props.description: Decorative content before the text, usually an icon. Defaults to a search icon when type="search".

props.name: trailing
props.description: Content after the text, usually an icon.

props.name: prefix
props.description: Text inside the field before the value, e.g. "$" or "https://".

props.name: suffix
props.description: Text inside the field after the value, e.g. "ft" or "%".

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Keyboard hint on the right, e.g. "⌘K".

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner in the trailing slot and marks the field busy.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Shows a clear button once the field has a value. Defaults to true when type="search".

props.name: revealable
props.description: Adds a show/hide toggle when type="password".

props.name: containerClassName
props.description: Classes for the wrapper that holds the adornments. Falls back onto the input when there is no wrapper.

props.name: completion
props.description: Suggests the rest of the value as ghost text, accepted with Tab or ArrowRight. Use completeFrom(list) for a fixed list; memoize async sources. Adding or removing it remounts the input, so keep it steady.

props.name: completionKeys
props.description: Keys that accept the suggestion. Defaults to Tab and ArrowRight.

props.name: ghost
props.description: Ghost text to draw after the value, for components that run useInlineCompletion themselves. Overrides `completion`. Pass "" while there's nothing to suggest; switching to undefined drops focus.

examples.title: minLength · maxLength
examples.code:
<TextField
  type="password"
  aria-label="Password"
  placeholder="8 to 32 characters"
  leading={<LockIcon />}
  minLength={8}
  maxLength={32}
  revealable
  validateOn="change"
/>

examples.title: error · from the server
examples.code:
<TextField
  aria-label="Invite code"
  defaultValue="JAY-2024"
  error="This invite code has expired."
/>

examples.title: pattern · custom message
examples.code:
<TextField
  aria-label="Job code"
  placeholder="AB-1234"
  pattern="[A-Z]{2}-[0-9]{4}"
  messages={{ pattern: "Use two capitals, a dash, then four digits." }}
  validateOn="change"
/>
